objective: Test a self-contained nonlinear equation model of two adjacent frozen Qwen memory blocks, carrying its own predicted memory into a second controlled token, without consuming changed native intermediate states.

model.loader: Original BF16 load followed by FP32 promotion; original trained weights unchanged
model.native_software: torch2.13.0+cpu, transformers5.19.0, numpy2.5.4; SDPA MATH/reference CPU kernels
model.equation_precision: NumPy FP64, with the declared external nudge rounded exactly as original FP32 input addition

subsystem.kind: Two complete neighboring linear-attention decoder blocks, including RMSNorm, all projections, convolution, recurrent update, gated readout, MLP and residual sums

allowed_predictor_inputs: Unchanged public trained parameters for blocks12/13
Normal prefix convolution and recurrent memories before token1
Normal upstream residual entering block12 at token1 andtoken2
Two deterministic orthonormal Gaussian directions and signed nudge magnitude
forbidden_predictor_inputs: Any steered native cache or memory
Native block13 inputs or outputs as boundary inputs
Native normal updated pair memories in place of its own calculated memories
causal_contract: Apply the input nudge to block12 only at token1. Token2 uses the preselected normal token and its normal upstream block12 input. Native upstream layers0–11 and that input must remain bitwise unchanged at token2. This is a two-block open subsystem under known boundary signals, not autonomous full-model free generation. Retain all changed next-greedy-token choices as scope diagnostics.
prediction_freeze: A separate NumPy-only process receives only whitelisted normal input packets, parameters and plan. It computes all normal and steered trajectories before any native steered forward. Hash every prediction and input before the native comparator reads any target. Preserve the process log and input schema.

questions.text: A jar holds seven blue buttons. Five are added and three are removed. Explain in one short sentence how many buttons are left.
A Python function receives the list [2, 4, 6] and returns [x * 3 for x in values]. Explain the returned result in one complete sentence.
Lina placed a silver coin in a small envelope, then moved the envelope into a green drawer. Explain where the coin is now in one complete sentence.
A greenhouse sensor reports 18 degrees before sunrise and 24 degrees at noon. Explain the temperature change in one complete sentence.
A club meets every third day, starting on Monday. Explain which weekday its next meeting falls on in one complete sentence.
Someone writes the sequence 3, 6, 12, 24. Explain the rule and the next number in one complete sentence.

input_template.system: Give a concise answer in one complete sentence.
input_template.EOS_policy: No forced EOS replacement; preserve admission failure if either controlled normal token is EOS.

nudges.construction: Two Gaussian columns orthonormalized in FP64 and stored FP32; fixed across questions, no semantic meaning assigned

controls.strict_native_null: Both tokens on both calibration questions; exact equality to native normal recordings, caller prefix caches remain immutable
controls.freeze_second_drivers: Only block13 recurrent write uses its own normal-trajectory K andf, while other computations remain driven by calculated changed activations
controls.freeze_second_stiffness: Only block13 write stiffness K is held at its own normal-trajectory value; its driving f is recalculated. Diagnostic, not a compulsory claim of stiffness importance.
controls.reset_memory_token2: At token2 use both blocks' own normal calculated memories instead of their carried steered memories. No direct token2 nudge.

equations.memory: S_new=S_old+f-K*S_old; f=beta*k*v^T; K=(1-gamma)I+gamma*beta*k*k^T. Compute all drivers from the predictor's own current activation/convolution window.
equations.finite_difference_decomposition: DeltaS_new=(I-K0)*DeltaS_old+Deltaf-DeltaK*S_old0-DeltaK*DeltaS_old. All four terms retained, exact finite identity.
equations.moving_conditions: Psi_t(S_t)-Psi_previous(S_previous)=[Psi_t(S_previous)-Psi_previous(S_previous)]+[Psi_t(S_t)-Psi_t(S_previous)]. Sum across the two memory components only with the fixed zero-at-S=0 convention; do not equate that accounting with physical interface work or a conserved global transformer energy.

secondary_geometry: Before native targets, full forecast vectors already define the response geometry. After comparison, report predicted/native size gain, turning relative to the delivered residual nudge, output angle between the two input axes, and the2x2 Gram eigenvalue ratio of signed central secant responses. Use full1024 residual outputs and full262144 memory coordinates, retaining the two-dimensional input-plane qualification. Also report even-response asymmetry from the signed nudges. These finite responses at magnitude0.125 are not claimed to be an infinitesimal Jacobian, full ambient spectrum, semantic direction map or extra primary gate. No extra native calls.

gates_frozen_before_any_new_model_forwar.baseline_and_target_values: All complete field errors<=1e-5*max(1,native field norm)
gates_frozen_before_any_new_model_forwar.finite_change_accuracy: Error between predicted and native finite changes<=max(0.01*native_change_norm,20*float32_epsilon*max(1,native_baseline_norm,native_target_norm)). Keep all unresolved cases; no dropping fields.
gates_frozen_before_any_new_model_forwar.required_resolved_targets: For every held question, direction and sign, block13 full recurrent state and block13 full residual output at both positions must have native change norm>5 times the stated float32 floor.
gates_frozen_before_any_new_model_forwar.mechanism_control: For each token position, median closed-model relative block13 memory-change error must be<=0.1 times the median error of frozen-second-drivers control. Normalized denominators use max(native_change_norm,numerical_floor). Reset-memory and frozen-K-only comparisons reported separately.
gates_frozen_before_any_new_model_forwar.native_energy_balance: All native head force residuals<=1e-5*max(1,force_norm,internal_norm); work balance uses ||force_residual||*||step|| plus100*float64_epsilon*max(1,absolute work/storage/dissipation), with1e-10 slack; retain all degenerate cases.
gates_frozen_before_any_new_model_forwar.calibration_stop: Both calibration questions must pass all value/change/strict-null/upstream gates before held steered forwards. No held-based protocol, direction or threshold changes.
gates_frozen_before_any_new_model_forwar.source_input_prediction_hashes: All match before and after targets; held target files absent at forecast freeze.

preservation: Keep all sources, exact input packets, public-parameter hashes and arrays, complete normal and target field vectors, all sealed forecasts and controls. Retain complete states/drivers and recipe for every finite state-change decomposition, with full term-vector SHA256 and norms; independently regenerate and verify every term rather than duplicate hundreds of MB of derived matrices. Save original failures; verify private host/Drive byte hashes, CRC and provider size/parent/shared=false. Stop owned workers/export services and close owned unused tabs. Do not touch Research3 or restart study09's stopped monitor.
interpretation: A connected nonlinear subsystem model retaining original trained matrices, not compression or a cheaper substitute. Initial normal memory and boundary signals are supplied per context; no per-context coefficients are fitted. No unknown-steering detector, semantic-direction dictionary, universal strong-nudge claim, physical heat or global conservation is implied.
